If  you're  feeling  unmotivated  at  the  end 
 of  the  year,  hear  me  out.  If  you  don't 
 have  confidence,  build  evidence.  If  you 
 don't  have  evidence,  build  skills.  If 
 you  don't  have  skills,  build  discipline. 
 And  if  you  don't  have  discipline,  you 
 need  to  reframe  the  things  you've  done 
 in  the  past.  Realize  that  you  have  that 
 discipline  just  in  different  domains.  So 
 you  have  the  core  skill,  you  should  to 
 apply  it  to  a  new  domain.
